exposure: time interval from cesarean delivery to subsequent frozen embryo transfer (FET)
cohort: Women undergoing autologous elective single embryo transfer FET after prior cesarean delivery (n=6,556)
finding: There were no significant differences in reproductive outcomes on the basis of the time interval from cesarean delivery to FET, including live birth.
birth_weight: Mean birth weight ranged from 3,181-3,470g, with a statistically significant increase over time
